skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the characteristics of operations, operational processes, organizational structure, and accounting system in the internship unit.
Evaluate and propose improvements for the organization's activities, organizational structure, and accounting system.
Apply IT skills in writing reports, including organizing and managing documentation, using software for document preparation and calculations.
Use critical thinking skills to critique and criticize the application of policies and methods in accounting units.
Utilize communication skills to write specialized reports related to accounting at the internship unit.
Demonstrate independent work skills, effective teamwork, professionalism, and high adaptability in work.
Show personal responsibility and accountability for group work.
Express and defend personal views based on objective and scientific approaches.
